start.title: Add AECC battery
start.intro: Discovery can fail across VLANs, mesh networks or when Homey runs in a container, so entering the IP address yourself is a normal choice, not a fallback.

manual.title: Enter the IP address
manual.intro: The battery must be reachable on TCP port 8080 and serves only one connection at a time.
manual.name: Display name
manual.name_hint: Optional. Shown as the device name in Homey.
manual.host_required: Enter a host or IP address.
manual.failed: Could not connect to the battery.

brand.title: Choose brand
brand.intro: The brand tunes sensor filtering and one AEG specific register. Pick Other if yours is not listed.
brand.power_hint: The local protocol caps power at 800W until this app raises the limit. Discharging above 800W also needs On Grid Output raised once in the vendor app.
